beautiful-mermaid.js is a generated ECMAScript module containing:

beautiful-mermaid 1.1.3 — MIT
  Mermaid parsing and SVG generation.
  License: LICENSE-beautiful-mermaid.txt
  Source: https://github.com/lukilabs/beautiful-mermaid
  Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/beautiful-mermaid/-/beautiful-mermaid-1.1.3.tgz

elkjs 0.11.1 — Eclipse Public License 2.0
  Diagram layout.
  License: LICENSE-elkjs.txt
  Source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs
  Upstream ELK source: https://github.com/eclipse-elk/elk
  Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.11.1.tgz
  Source code for this component is available under EPL-2.0 from these
  upstream repositories and their source releases.
  This bundle applies the source transformation in elkjs-herdr.js (EPL-2.0).
  It defines the Java Object prototype's own toString method explicitly,
  allowing it to inherit from Herdr's frozen JavaScript Object prototype.
  Deferred worker startup replies use Promise microtasks instead of a
  global timer, which is unavailable in Herdr's JavaScript host.

entities 7.0.1 — BSD-2-Clause
  HTML entity decoding used by the parser.
  License: LICENSE-entities.txt
  Source: https://github.com/fb55/entities
  Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/entities/-/entities-7.0.1.tgz

Bundle generation
  Tool: esbuild 0.28.2 (build-time only; not needed to run this Mod).
  Entry: export { renderMermaidSVG } from "beautiful-mermaid";
  Exact package versions: those listed above.
  Options: bundle=true, format=esm, platform=neutral, target=es2022,
    define:global=globalThis, define:window=globalThis, minify=true, charset=utf8,
    legalComments=inline, sourcemap=false.
  Before bundling elkjs/lib/elk.bundled.js, apply patchElk from elkjs-herdr.js.
  The global and window bindings are mapped to globalThis for Herdr's JavaScript host.
  SVG color and font compatibility is handled by ../mermaid.js.
